people.story: Father of Christa Kohlmann and Sigrid Michaelis. Thomas Kohlmann's maternal grandfather. Fabrikant: sole proprietor (Inhaber) of Stahldrahtmatratzen-Fabrik Weickert & Eifler, the steel wire mattress factory based in Bautzen, with offices at Martin-Mutschmann-Straße 19 (a Nazi-period street name) and a factory on the Industriegelände Singwitz served by a private rail siding at Gnaschwitz. The firm name preserves a founding partner Weickert who was no longer active by the 1930s; circumstances of Weickert's exit unknown. Documented as proprietor in two surviving company papers: an undated advertising letterhead (1933–1945) and a business invoice dated 9 April 1943. Married Gertrud Elise Becker on 2 October 1926 in Dresden (the chart types 'Dresdan', a typo). Twelve years older than her at marriage. Died of a Schädelbasisbruch (basilar skull fracture) in a car accident, aged 76. Had three siblings on the chart: brothers Max and Alfred and sister Martha (no further details on page 1). Rufname underlined on the chart was 'Alwin', and Documents B and C confirm he went by Alwin in business.[^ahnentafel-2007][^weickert-letterhead][^weickert-invoice-1943]

people.story: Mother of Christa Kohlmann and Sigrid Michaelis. Thomas Kohlmann's maternal grandmother. Daughter of Richard Hermann Becker and Elise Becker (née Just). Twenty-one years old at her marriage to Ernst Alwin Eifler on 2 October 1926 in Dresden. Documented as actively involved in the bookkeeping side of her husband's firm Weickert & Eifler: a surviving company invoice from 9 April 1943 carries her ink signature acknowledging payment received three weeks later, 'Betrag dankend erhalten. Gertrud Eifler. d. 28.4.1943.' She would have been 38 at the time. Died of cancer (Krebs) at age 68. Rufname underlined on the chart was 'Gertrud'.[^ahnentafel-2007][^weickert-invoice-1943]
